topic: Conditional sentences (if-clauses and main clauses): Find the correct conditions
title: Which Condition Fits?

explanation.tr:
Bu alıştırmada ana cümleye uyan if kısmını bulacaksın. Zamanlara bak:
• will + fiil → if + present simple (1. tip)
• would + fiil → if + past simple (2. tip)
• would have + V3 → if + had + V3 (3. tip)
• Sıfır tip (genel gerçekler): If + present simple, present simple → If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
Anlam da önemli: koşul ile sonuç mantıklı bağlanmalı.
explanation.tk:
Bu gönükmede esasy bölege laýyk gelýän if bölegini taparsyň. Zamanlara seret:
• will + işlik → if + present simple (1-nji görnüş)
• would + işlik → if + past simple (2-nji görnüş)
• would have + V3 → if + had + V3 (3-nji görnüş)
• Nol görnüş (umumy hakykatlar): If + present simple, present simple → If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
Manysy hem möhüm: şert bilen netije manyly baglanyşmaly.
explanation.ru:
В этом упражнении нужно подобрать часть с if к главной части. Смотри на времена:
• will + глагол → if + present simple (1-й тип)
• would + глагол → if + past simple (2-й тип)
• would have + V3 → if + had + V3 (3-й тип)
• Нулевой тип (общие истины): If + present simple, present simple → If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
Важен и смысл: условие и результат должны логично сочетаться.

topic: Conditional sentences (if-clauses and main clauses): Match the if-clauses to the main clauses
title: Matching If-Clauses and Main Clauses

explanation.tr:
Bir koşul cümlesi iki parçadan oluşur: if kısmı (koşul) ve ana cümle (sonuç). Doğru eşleştirmek için:
1. Zaman uyumuna bak (present → will, past → would, had + V3 → would have + V3).
2. Anlamı kontrol et: koşul mantıklı olarak sonuca yol açmalı.
• If you lose your key, ... → you won't get into the house.
• If I were a cook, ... → I would open a restaurant.
Virgül kuralı: if başta ise virgül gelir; sonda ise virgül gerekmez.
explanation.tk:
Şert sözlemi iki bölekden durýar: if bölegi (şert) we esasy bölek (netije). Dogry jübütlemek üçin:
1. Zamanlaryň laýyklygyna seret (present → will, past → would, had + V3 → would have + V3).
2. Manysyny barla: şert manyly ýagdaýda netijä getirmeli.
• If you lose your key, ... → you won't get into the house.
• If I were a cook, ... → I would open a restaurant.
Otur düzgüni: if başda bolsa otur goýulýar; ahyrda bolsa otur gerek däl.
explanation.ru:
Условное предложение состоит из двух частей: части с if (условие) и главной части (результат). Чтобы правильно соединить:
1. Смотри на согласование времён (present → will, past → would, had + V3 → would have + V3).
2. Проверь смысл: условие должно логично вести к результату.
• If you lose your key, ... → you won't get into the house.
• If I were a cook, ... → I would open a restaurant.
Запятая: если if в начале — ставится запятая; если в конце — не нужна.

topic: Gerund and infinitive: Gerund as subject or object
title: The Gerund as Subject and Object

explanation.tr:
Gerund, fiile -ing eklenerek yapılan ve isim gibi kullanılan biçimdir.
• Özne olarak: Swimming is good for your health. (Yüzmek sağlığa iyidir.)
• Nesne olarak: I enjoy reading. / She hates waiting.
• Edattan sonra her zaman gerund gelir: She is good at drawing. Thank you for helping.
• Gerund özne olduğunda fiil tekildir: Learning languages is fun.
• Olumsuz: Not sleeping enough makes you tired.
Yazım: make → making, run → running, lie → lying.
explanation.tk:
Gerund — işlige -ing goşulyp ýasalýan we at ýaly ulanylýan görnüş.
• Eýe hökmünde: Swimming is good for your health. (Ýüzmek saglyga peýdaly.)
• Doldurgyç hökmünde: I enjoy reading. / She hates waiting.
• Sözlemden (preposition) soň elmydama gerund gelýär: She is good at drawing. Thank you for helping.
• Gerund eýe bolanda işlik birlikde bolýar: Learning languages is fun.
• Ýokluk: Not sleeping enough makes you tired.
Ýazylyşy: make → making, run → running, lie → lying.
explanation.ru:
Герундий — форма глагола с -ing, которая употребляется как существительное.
• Как подлежащее: Swimming is good for your health. (Плавание полезно для здоровья.)
• Как дополнение: I enjoy reading. / She hates waiting.
• После предлогов всегда герундий: She is good at drawing. Thank you for helping.
• Если герундий — подлежащее, глагол в ед. ч.: Learning languages is fun.
• Отрицание: Not sleeping enough makes you tired.
Орфография: make → making, run → running, lie → lying.

topic: Gerund and infinitive: Gerund or Progressive
title: Gerund or Progressive Form?

explanation.tr:
-ing biçimi iki farklı görevde kullanılır:
• Progressive (süreklilik): be + V-ing → devam eden bir eylem.
  She is reading a book. (Şu an okuyor.)
• Gerund: isim gibi kullanılır; önünde 'be' yoktur ya da 'be' sadece bağlaçtır.
  Reading is relaxing. / My hobby is reading. (Hobim okumaktır.)
İpucu: 'My hobby is reading' cümlesinde reading = hobi (isim) → gerund.
'He is reading' → ne yapıyor? → progressive.
explanation.tk:
-ing görnüşi iki dürli wezipede ulanylýar:
• Progressive (dowamlylyk): be + V-ing → dowam edýän hereket.
  She is reading a book. (Häzir okaýar.)
• Gerund: at ýaly ulanylýar; öňünde 'be' ýok ýa-da 'be' diňe baglaýjy.
  Reading is relaxing. / My hobby is reading. (Meniň gyzyklanmam — okamak.)
Maslahat: 'My hobby is reading' sözleminde reading = gyzyklanma (at) → gerund.
'He is reading' → näme edýär? → progressive.
explanation.ru:
Форма на -ing выполняет две разные роли:
• Progressive (длительное время): be + V-ing → действие в процессе.
  She is reading a book. (Она сейчас читает.)
• Gerund: используется как существительное; перед ним нет 'be' или 'be' — просто связка.
  Reading is relaxing. / My hobby is reading. (Моё хобби — чтение.)
Подсказка: в 'My hobby is reading' reading = хобби (существительное) → герундий.
'He is reading' → что он делает? → progressive.

topic: Gerund and infinitive: Infinitive of English verbs
title: The Infinitive: to + Verb

explanation.tr:
Infinitive (mastar), fiilin yalın hâlidir. İki türü var:
• to + fiil: to go, to eat, to learn
• to'suz (bare infinitive): can, must, will, should, let, make sonrasında → I can swim. Let me help.
to + fiil şu durumlarda kullanılır:
• want, need, decide, hope, plan, would like + to: I want to travel.
• Amaç bildirmek için (… için): I went to the shop to buy milk.
• Sıfattan sonra: It's easy to learn. / Nice to meet you.
• Olumsuz: not to + fiil → He decided not to go.
explanation.tk:
Infinitive (nämälim forma) — işligiň esasy görnüşi. Iki görnüşi bar:
• to + işlik: to go, to eat, to learn
• to-suz (bare infinitive): can, must, will, should, let, make-den soň → I can swim. Let me help.
to + işlik şu ýagdaýlarda ulanylýar:
• want, need, decide, hope, plan, would like + to: I want to travel.
• Maksady aňlatmak üçin (… üçin): I went to the shop to buy milk.
• Sypatdan soň: It's easy to learn. / Nice to meet you.
• Ýokluk: not to + işlik → He decided not to go.
explanation.ru:
Инфинитив — начальная форма глагола. Бывает двух видов:
• to + глагол: to go, to eat, to learn
• без to (bare infinitive): после can, must, will, should, let, make → I can swim. Let me help.
to + глагол используется:
• после want, need, decide, hope, plan, would like: I want to travel.
• для выражения цели (чтобы): I went to the shop to buy milk.
• после прилагательных: It's easy to learn. / Nice to meet you.
• Отрицание: not to + глагол → He decided not to go.

topic: Gerund and infinitive: Infinitive or Gerund after verbs
title: Verb + Gerund or Verb + Infinitive?

explanation.tr:
Bazı fiillerden sonra gerund (-ing), bazılarından sonra infinitive (to + fiil) gelir.
• Gerund alan fiiller: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, suggest, keep, practise, imagine, miss, give up
  I enjoy swimming. Do you mind waiting?
• Infinitive alan fiiller: want, decide, hope, plan, agree, promise, refuse, learn, manage, afford, offer
  She decided to leave.
• İkisini de alabilen fiiller: like, love, hate, start, begin, continue (anlam pek değişmez)
• Anlamı değişenler: stop, remember, forget, try
  I stopped smoking. (Bıraktım.) / I stopped to smoke. (Sigara içmek için durdum.)
explanation.tk:
Käbir işliklerden soň gerund (-ing), käbirlerinden soň infinitive (to + işlik) gelýär.
• Gerund alýan işlikler: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, suggest, keep, practise, imagine, miss, give up
  I enjoy swimming. Do you mind waiting?
• Infinitive alýan işlikler: want, decide, hope, plan, agree, promise, refuse, learn, manage, afford, offer
  She decided to leave.
• Ikisini hem alyp bilýänler: like, love, hate, start, begin, continue (manysy kän üýtgemeýär)
• Manysy üýtgeýänler: stop, remember, forget, try
  I stopped smoking. (Taşladym.) / I stopped to smoke. (Çilim çekmek üçin durdum.)
explanation.ru:
После одних глаголов идёт герундий (-ing), после других — инфинитив (to + глагол).
• С герундием: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, suggest, keep, practise, imagine, miss, give up
  I enjoy swimming. Do you mind waiting?
• С инфинитивом: want, decide, hope, plan, agree, promise, refuse, learn, manage, afford, offer
  She decided to leave.
• И то, и другое: like, love, hate, start, begin, continue (смысл почти не меняется)
• Смысл меняется: stop, remember, forget, try
  I stopped smoking. (Бросил курить.) / I stopped to smoke. (Остановился, чтобы покурить.)
